_meta.purpose: Verified constants bank for market-analysis rounds. Injected into every analyst so verified facts are never re-derived or re-broken. Update ONLY with adversarially verified values; keep the source and date.

royal_mail_2026.source: verified round 2 + round 4 fact-checks, Apr 2026 price guide

fulfilment_uk.live_animals: Only Royal Mail carries live invertebrates (enumerated permitted list); Parcelforce, Evri, DPD, UPS prohibit all live creatures. Etsy and Amazon ban live animals; eBay allows.
fulfilment_uk.etsy_fees_all_in: ~13-17% incl. VAT-on-fees; UK regulatory operating fee 0.32%→0.48% from 22 Jun 2026
fulfilment_uk.amazon_grocery: gated category: council registration + compliant label photos required; GTIN must be GS1-registered to the seller (~£99+VAT/yr); FBA requires ~105 days shelf life inbound

demand_acquisition.d2c_food_cac: £12-28 blended paid CAC vs typical £8 first-order margin — paid acquisition structurally unprofitable for cold food brands
demand_acquisition.youtube_growth: median new channel needs ~15.5 months to reach 1,000 subscribers; plans requiring 10k+ in year 1 are top-5% outcomes

grants_finance_scotland.ffis: ≤£20,000 at 80% intervention for new entrants; Round 2 winter 2026; competitive (~725 funded in round 1, £14.25M pot); requires RPID registration; container/CEA eligibility unconfirmed — treat as upside, never as plan

regulatory_scotland.food_registration: free, cannot be refused, ≥28 days before first sale, per-premises with the local council; domestic kitchens registrable; Scotland uses CookSafe (NOT the English SFBB pack) and FHIS Pass/Improvement-Required (not 0-5 stars)
regulatory_scotland.novel_foods_blocked: mushroom MYCELIUM powders (all species), cordyceps militaris as food; lion's mane/oyster/shiitake FRUITING BODY and its powder are NOT novel (verified vs EU catalogue)
regulatory_scotland.health_claims: no authorised claims for mushrooms; ASA actively enforces (memory/focus/stress claims banned)
regulatory_scotland.animal_products: premises APPROVAL (retained 853/2004) applies to products of animal origin only; plant-based foods need registration only. Pet food from animal by-products needs FSS feed registration (direct, feed@fss.scot, since Apr 2021) AND APHA plant approval BEFORE first sale; domestic premises approvable only with strict separation from the family kitchen
regulatory_scotland.plants_distance_selling: SASA professional-operator registration free; plant-passport authorisation mandatory for ALL online plant sales incl. hobbyist-scale (inspection ~£120-250/yr); felled birch/oak logs need NO passport (conifer and sweet chestnut do); no GB passports valid for NI
regulatory_scotland.invertebrates: outside Scottish pet-selling licensing (s.16 AHW(S)A 2006 defines animal = vertebrate; crustaceans excluded per gov.scot guidance); ornamental aquatic breeding: get free written FHI/APB scope confirmation
regulatory_scotland.honey: Honey (Scotland) Regulations 2015 reserve the name 'honey' for pure honey — infused products need a qualified name (e.g. 'chilli infused honey preparation')
regulatory_scotland.alcohol: mead/'made-wine' requires excise approval — kills home phase-0; vinegar from bought alcohol: verify duty status per input
regulatory_scotland.firewood: Ready to Burn is England-only law; Scotland at consultation stage (2026)

market_sizes_verified.uk_functional_mushroom_supplements: ~£100-200m retail (headline $1.85bn figures are ~10x inflated — MRFR $174m cross-check)
market_sizes_verified.uk_craft_koji: sub-£2m; 5 micro-producers incl. one serving Edinburgh since 2020
market_sizes_verified.uk_oyster_wholesale_price: £6.92/kg (Foodomarket Jul 2026, flat 12 months); small growers net £9-13/kg restaurants, £12-20 direct; Sainsbury's lion's mane £25/kg retail (compression signal)
market_sizes_verified.vendor_reports_rule: cross-check every market headline on ≥2 independent sources; >3x divergence → use conservative bottom-up

post_mortems.freight_farms: Ch.7 2025: ~600 units ever sold at ~$150k to buyers who couldn't profit; Growcer rescued the software — there is NO orphan market; lesson: never sell kit to unprofitable operators; local-first no-cloud design
post_mortems.smallhold: Ch.11 2024: VC-scale facilities + national wholesale commodity pricing; re-emerged as asset-light partner-farm network
post_mortems.vertical_lettuce: energy 40-60% of opex; 11-15 kWh/kg viability threshold; fungi at 2.2 kWh/kg escape this wall
post_mortems.mara_seaweed: Scotland's flagship seaweed brand exited — leader-exit signal for that category
post_mortems.edible_flowers_uk: both flagship producers (Greens of Devon, Maddocks Farm) exited 2025-26
post_mortems.sow_good: US freeze-dried candy leader -88% revenue 2025; CPG majors took the shelf — window closed

operator_verified.fungi_labor: artisan ~1h/kg all-in; operator stack ~0.3h/kg (survived adversarial attack); contamination 10-15%→~5% via early vision detection; multi-site <5h/wk/site feasible; solo mature £26k, multi-site D2C-weighted £58k Y5 at credibility 5/10
operator_verified.container_costs: 20ft £1,550 buy / £17wk hire (CS Containers Grangemouth, verified to the pound); DIY fungi fit-out ~£3k vs £15-60k turnkey
